description: Rulings on CAS numbers CAS Common Chemistry answers for with a definite molecular formula and no InChIKey. That shape is genuinely ambiguous and the pipeline cannot resolve it: an unspecified isomer such as 1300-21-6 `Dichloroethane` (C2H4Cl2) and a specific molecule Common Chemistry happens to lack a key for, such as 10028-15-6 `Ozone` (O3), are indistinguishable in the record. 319 cached records have this shape. The default is to do nothing, so a substance is only ever denied a structure by a ruling written here. Numbers whose formula Common Chemistry gives as `Unspecified` need no entry -- that is CAS stating the composition is indefinite, and the pipeline acts on it directly. `comment` is mandatory and must say why the number is ambiguous; an entry without one is ignored and reported as if unlisted. See `brightway_flows.transformers.enrich_references`.
